id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Unique across the whole corpus. Never renamed once shipped, because links and search history point at it.

cardRef.description: A reference to another card's id. The linter fails the build if it does not resolve.

volatility.description: How fast this card's claims rot. Drives the stale badge, which only appears once a card passes its own budget. low: data models, language syntax. quarterly: file layouts, conventions. weekly: install commands, model names, agent CLI flags.

track.description: A orientation, B setup, C how code runs, D git and GitHub, E working with agents, F reading failure, G the supply chain, H proving it works, I shipping, J recognition

verify.description: A command Nyx can run to test this card's central claim herself. Required by the linter on any card containing an install command. Generalizes the seed doc's 'if it prints a version number, you are done'.

see_also.description: Neighbors, not everything related. Eight is already a lot.

keywords.description: Extra lexical search terms that do not appear in the prose. Spellings, plurals, and the wrong-but-common name for the thing.

danger.description: Required by the linter when the card contains a destructive command. States what is destroyed and names the safe alternative.
